summary: Adversarial visual-diff: compare each rendered screen against its WHOOP reference and list mismatches

mismatches.expected: Recovery ring arc is GREEN for a recovered score (≥67%), data-driven by zone (green ≥67 / yellow 34-66 / red ≤33)
mismatches.actual: Our Recovery ring arc is YELLOW even though it should be color-driven by the recovery zone

mismatches.expected: Full-width card with notebook illustration, 'Set Up Your Journal' heading, 'Customize your daily routine and fill out your first entry.' subtext, and a 'LET'S GO' pill button, placed between Tonight's Sleep and My Plan
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely

mismatches.element: 'My Plan' section and 'Build Your Best Self' card
mismatches.expected: 'My Plan' section header followed by a 'Build Your Best Self' card ('Set goals, track progress...', 'EXPLORE PLANS →' link, three ringed icons)
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely; our render goes from Tonight's Sleep straight to My Dashboard

mismatches.expected: A 'Your Daily Outlook' row (sun icon, chevron) under the 'My Day' header, above Today's Activities
mismatches.actual: Missing; My Day goes straight to Today's Activities

mismatches.expected: Steps shows a numeric value (e.g. 262) with a secondary baseline (6,094) and trend arrow
mismatches.actual: Steps shows an em-dash '—' placeholder with no value

mismatches.expected: HR ZONES 1-3, HR ZONES 4-5, STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME, CALORIES display time/number values (e.g. 0:14, 0:00, 0:00, 1,012) each with a secondary baseline value
mismatches.actual: All show '—' placeholders with no secondary value

mismatches.expected: A 'Discover More' section header with content (e.g. 'Go to Advanced Labs') below the metric rows at the bottom
mismatches.actual: Missing; our render ends at Respiratory Rate

mismatches.element: Stress Monitor chart axes and overlays
mismatches.expected: Y-axis labeled 0.0–3.0, a shaded sleep band capped at 3.0, a moon icon marking the sleep period, x-axis real times (21:32 / 02:00 / 05:00 / 09:25)
mismatches.actual: No Y-axis scale labels, no sleep shaded band, no moon marker; x-axis shows generic 00:00–20:00 hours

mismatches.expected: Recovery percent dots colored by zone (green high 97/94/81/67%, yellow mid 40%, red low 25%); right axis ticks 100/66/33/0%
mismatches.actual: Recovery dots/labels render as a mostly-yellow series without per-point zone coloring

mismatches.expected: Top-right shows a band-battery percentage pill (e.g. 11%) with band icon
mismatches.actual: Top-right shows a generic battery glyph without the band-battery percentage styling

mismatches.expected: 'WITHIN RANGE' uppercase on one line, '5/5 Metrics'
mismatches.actual: 'Within range' in title case wrapping to two lines, '5/5 metrics' lowercase

mismatches.expected: Sunset/sunrise icons beside the 23:30 and 07:30 times plus a 'SET ALARM' button row beneath
mismatches.actual: Icons differ (moon-style icon used) and SET ALARM button not visible

mismatches.expected: Resting Heart Rate shows a green down-arrow (lower is good)
mismatches.actual: Our RHR shows an orange/amber up-arrow; trend color/direction logic differs

mismatches.element: Today's Activities sleep start time prefix
mismatches.expected: Start time shown with day prefix like '[Mon] 22:51'
mismatches.actual: Shows '22:51' with no day prefix

mismatches.expected: Large number with a '%' suffix (e.g. '67%') and label 'RECOVERY' below it; recovery is a percentage
mismatches.actual: Bare number '64' with NO percent sign, and the label below is a qualitative word 'ADEQUATE' instead of 'RECOVERY'

mismatches.expected: WHOOP uses the recovery color band: green for high recovery (67% is green), yellow ~34-66%, red <=33%. A 64-67% score renders GREEN.
mismatches.actual: Dial arc is rendered YELLOW for a 64 score. WHOOP color thresholds put this in green territory; yellow implies a lower/mid score so the color mapping is wrong.

mismatches.expected: Each metric shows a small baseline/30-day value beneath the big number (e.g. HRV 90 with '75' under it) plus an up/down trend triangle (green up, red down). A footer row reads 'Today vs. last 30 days'.
mismatches.actual: No baseline number shown; instead shows a horizontal slider/range bar with 'typical 55-95 ms' on the left and 'vs 30-day' text on the right. Trend triangles are missing (replaced by a green dot). Different layout/metaphor entirely.

mismatches.expected: Each metric row has a distinct left icon: HRV = waveform/pulse line, RHR = heart with down-arrow, Respiratory = lungs, Sleep = crescent moon.
mismatches.actual: No per-metric icons; rows use a generic colored status dot only.

mismatches.expected: Fourth metric is 'SLEEP PERFORMANCE' shown as a percentage (e.g. 86%).
mismatches.actual: Sleep Performance is missing from the metrics list. Instead 'Blood oxygen' and 'Skin temperature' rows appear, which are not part of WHOOP's recovery metric card.

mismatches.expected: A 'Weekly Trends' section with multiple per-metric cards: RECOVERY (bar chart, color-coded red/yellow/green per day), HEART RATE VARIABILITY (line chart with point labels), RESTING HEART RATE (line chart), RESPIRATORY RATE (line chart), SLEEP PERFORMANCE (bar chart). Each card has a header and a '>' chevron, x-axis day labels (Wed 24 ... Tue 30).
mismatches.actual: Only a single 'RECOVERY - 14 DAYS' area/line chart (yellow filled) is present. Missing the per-metric HRV / RHR / Respiratory / Sleep trend charts and the multi-card 'Weekly Trends' structure.

mismatches.expected: Recovery trend is a BAR chart with one bar per day, each bar color-coded by recovery zone (red/yellow/green) and labeled with its % above the bar; x-axis shows day-of-week + date.
mismatches.actual: Rendered as a continuous yellow area/line chart labeled '14 DAYS' with x-axis '-13d ... -1d' relative labels. Wrong chart type, wrong axis labeling, no per-bar colors or value labels.

mismatches.expected: Metric titles are UPPERCASE ('HEART RATE VARIABILITY', 'RESTING HEART RATE', 'RESPIRATORY RATE') and values have no explicit unit text shown inline.
mismatches.actual: Titles are Title Case ('Heart rate variability') and units are spelled out inline ('ms', 'bpm', 'rpm', '%', '°C').

mismatches.expected: A bordered insight card with body text plus a colored call-to-action link 'EXPLORE YOUR RECOVERY INSIGHTS ->' (purple/blue, with arrow).
mismatches.actual: Plain explanatory paragraph only, no bordered card, no CTA link or arrow.

mismatches.expected: Centered header reads 'TODAY' with a back chevron left and an info (i) circle icon right.
mismatches.actual: Left-aligned header reads 'RECOVERY' with a 'PREVIEW · SAMPLE' badge on the right; no info icon. (Title text and right-side control differ.)

mismatches.expected: WHOOP shows respiratory rate as a plain number (rpm implied), no unit text on the dial card.
mismatches.actual: Shows 'rpm' inline; minor but WHOOP abbreviates differently / omits it.

mismatches.expected: Dial center has faint 'WHOOP' wordmark above the number.
mismatches.actual: No center wordmark (acceptable for our brand, noted as a subtle visual difference).

mismatches.expected: Ring center shows a percent value with a '%' symbol (e.g. '86%') above the label 'SLEEP PERFORMANCE'
mismatches.actual: Ring center shows a bare number '85' (no % sign) above label 'PERFORMANCE' (missing the word 'SLEEP')

mismatches.element: Sleep breakdown card (Hours vs Needed / Consistency / Efficiency / Stress)
mismatches.expected: A prominent card directly under the ring listing HOURS VS. NEEDED, SLEEP CONSISTENCY, SLEEP EFFICIENCY, HIGH SLEEP STRESS, each with an icon, a segmented colored status bar (Poor/Sufficient/Optimal) and a percentage, plus a colored legend row
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely; replaced by an unrelated 'SLEEP STAGES' hypnogram card

mismatches.expected: 'Last Night's Sleep' section with a 'HOURS OF SLEEP' card showing duration (9:16), a heart-rate waveform line chart across the night with 22:31 / 08:40 start/end markers and a 30-90 axis
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely

mismatches.expected: Stages shown as a TYPICAL RANGE list: Awake/Light/SWS(DEEP)/REM each with a horizontal range bar (filled bar vs. hatched typical-range zone), percentage, and duration; colors are purple/violet/pink family
mismatches.actual: Shown as a small hypnogram block chart plus a simple list (REM/Deep(SWS)/Light/Awake) using blue tones; no typical-range range bars

mismatches.expected: WHOOP uses violet/purple for Light, pink/magenta for SWS(Deep), bright purple for REM
mismatches.actual: Uses light-blue for Light, dark navy for Deep, light-blue for REM (wrong color palette)

mismatches.expected: A dedicated 'SLEEP CONSISTENCY' card with a 69% value, trend arrow, prior baseline %, and a 5-day (Fri-Tue) bar chart of bed/wake times with dashed 'OPTIMAL BED/WAKETIME' lines
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely (only a '— CONSISTENCY' stat tile with no value/chart)

mismatches.expected: A dedicated 'SLEEP EFFICIENCY' card with 92% value, ASLEEP vs AWAKE segmented bars, and a 'WAKE EVENTS' count
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely (only a '— EFFICIENCY' stat tile with no value)

mismatches.expected: A 'SLEEP STRESS' card with 0% value, a stress line chart over the night, and HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW breakdown bars with durations
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely

mismatches.expected: A 'Weekly Trends' section with a 'SLEEP PERFORMANCE' bar chart across multiple days (76%/84%/90%...)
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely

mismatches.expected: A 'RESTORATIVE SLEEP' row with a value (4:54) and baseline (4:00) plus trend arrow
mismatches.actual: Missing

mismatches.expected: Sleep need broken into 'Healthy Minimum', 'Recent Strain', 'Sleep Debt' (WHOOP labels)
mismatches.actual: Uses different labels: 'Baseline need', 'From sleep debt', 'Credited from naps'

mismatches.expected: Centered header reads 'TODAY' with an info (i) icon at top-right
mismatches.actual: Left-aligned header reads 'SLEEP' with a 'YOUR DATA' pill at top-right (wrong title and wrong right-side control)

mismatches.expected: Not present in WHOOP reference sleep detail screens
mismatches.actual: A 'SLEEP COACH' navigation row is present (extra element not in reference)

mismatches.expected: WHOOP surfaces respiratory rate and wake events within their respective cards, not as a combined bottom tile row
mismatches.actual: Combined tile row with 'RESP·RPM', 'DISTURBANCES', 'TIME IN BED' showing dashes for missing values

mismatches.expected: Reference does not show 'asleep / in bed' text directly under the ring (in-bed/asleep durations live in the breakdown cards)
mismatches.actual: Shows '6h 18m asleep · 6h 32m in bed' under the ring

mismatches.element: Day Strain primary visualization (ring vs bar)
mismatches.expected: WHOOP shows a large circular RING DIAL with the strain number centered inside it, the word 'WHOOP' above the number inside the ring, and 'STRAIN' below it. The ring has colored tick/progress segments around its circumference.
mismatches.actual: Our render uses a flat HORIZONTAL linear gradient bar (0/7/14/21 scale) with a glowing dot marker and the number above it. Completely different chart type from WHOOP's circular ring.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP has a large 'Weekly Trends' section containing multiple 7-day bar charts: STRAIN, HR ZONES 1-3, HR ZONES 4-5, STEPS, CALORIES, and STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME — each with day/date x-axis (Wed 24 ... Tue 30), value labels above bars, and the current day column highlighted.
mismatches.actual: Entire Weekly Trends section and all its bar charts are MISSING from our render.

mismatches.element: Summary metric rows below the dial
mismatches.expected: WHOOP shows a list of summary rows directly under the ring, each with an icon: 'HEART RATE ZONES 1-3', 'HEART RATE ZONES 4-5', 'STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME', and 'STEPS', each showing a primary value, a secondary baseline value beneath it, and a colored up/down trend arrow.
mismatches.actual: This grouped summary list (with icons, baseline comparison values, and trend arrows) is missing. We instead show a 'TIME IN HEART-RATE ZONES' list broken into Zone 0–5.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP prominently features STEPS both as a summary row (262 with baseline 6,094) and as a dedicated weekly bar chart.
mismatches.actual: Steps are entirely absent from our render.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP includes a CALORIES weekly bar chart (e.g. 2,146 / 2,568 / 1,012).
mismatches.actual: Calories are entirely absent from our render.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP groups HR zones as 'Zones 1-3' and 'Zones 4-5' (5 zones total, 1–5), shown as summary rows and stacked bar charts.
mismatches.actual: Our render uses 6 zones (Zone 0 through Zone 5) listed individually with horizontal progress bars. Different zone model and numbering (we include a Zone 0).

mismatches.expected: WHOOP shows a bordered gradient card: 'Your body is signaling it's ready to perform today. Aim for moderate Day Strain between 10.0 and 14.0...' with an 'EXPLORE YOUR STRAIN INSIGHTS →' link.
mismatches.actual: Missing. We have an 'ACTIVITIES' card with 'No tagged activities' text instead.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP header is centered title 'TODAY' with a back chevron on the left and a circular info (i) icon on the right.
mismatches.actual: Our header is left-aligned title 'STRAIN' with a 'YOUR DATA' green pill on the right and a back chevron; no info icon, title text differs.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP shows a small pill/legend row with green-up and orange-down arrows reading 'Today vs last 30 days', tying the trend arrows to a baseline comparison.
mismatches.actual: Missing entirely.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP labels zones by number group (Zones 1-3, 4-5) and uses %HRR coloring in charts; it does not surface 'Restorative 50-60%', 'Very light 60-70%' style descriptors on this screen.
mismatches.actual: Our render adds verbose descriptors (Restorative 50-60%, Very light, Light, Moderate, Hard, Max) per zone row that don't appear in the WHOOP strain screen.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP has a 'STRENGTH ACTIVITY TIME' summary row and weekly bar chart (0:00 values).
mismatches.actual: Missing from our render.

mismatches.expected: WHOOP renders the central strain number in white inside the ring; accent trend arrows are green/orange.
mismatches.actual: Our strain number '11.0' is rendered in bright blue, and our accent system (green 'YOUR DATA' pill, blue gradient bar) diverges from WHOOP's white-number + green/orange-arrow scheme.

mismatches.expected: HRV trend line is BLUE (light/sky blue), WHOOP's standard HRV colour
mismatches.actual: Trend line is rendered in green (Strain/recovery-style green)

mismatches.expected: Left Y-axis shows numeric gridline labels (e.g. 0, 49, 98, 147 ms scale) with horizontal gridlines
mismatches.actual: No Y-axis labels and no horizontal gridlines at all

mismatches.actual: Rendered as a single bordered dashed box reading 'OPTIMAL · 00:00 - 08:25' on one line — wrong combined format and a full box rather than a bracket.
